verdict.rationale: The Claude Code marketplace path installs plugin bundles (`document-skills`, `example-skills`), and a plugin installs and loads as one unit, so install granularity is the group, not the individual skill. Per-skill selection does exist elsewhere: on the API you pick individual skills by `skill_id` (`pptx`, `xlsx`, `docx`, `pdf`, up to 20 per request), and the Agent SDK lets you control which skills sessions can invoke. Skills are also standalone folders that could be added individually. Missing for 10: per-skill install from the marketplace collection in Claude Code, a documented cherry-pick/selective install flow (only all-or-nothing `disableBundledSkills`), and hands-on corroboration of selective install.
